run_extract_wav2vec_features: run the script to extract wav2vec features from audio files listed in a TSV split file
run_wav2vec_feature_reader: run the Wav2VecFeatureReader class to load a checkpoint and extract features from a single audio file
create_feature_iterator: create an iterator that yields wav2vec features for each audio file in a TSV manifest
review_get_feats_method: review the get_feats method that normalizes audio input and extracts features from a specific model layer
review_read_audio_method: review the read_audio method that loads a WAV file and validates the 16kHz sample rate
